name: shimmer-text
title: Shimmer text
description: Words that say something is working: a lighter band runs across them for as long as the work does. Reduced motion shows them still.
use_for: A search or a sync under way, in the few words that say so.
never: A shimmering block in place of a loading row (rows keep their layout)
body: The band runs right to left every 1.4s in the muted grey's lighter step. Remove it when the work ends, and put the sentence in `role="status"` so the change is read out. Pair it with the dot matrix (Loader) when the wait is long.
